rules: Headings must use tight tracking (tracking-tight) and avoid generic sans defaults.
Config outputs, diffs, and technical logs MUST use JetBrains Mono for perfect alignment.
Use explicit line heights (leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body).
No full-screen gradients. Color is for function and status only.
Use tinted dark grays instead of pure black for reduced eye strain.
Hover states must be explicitly defined and provide higher contrast.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp solid borders (border-border) on all containers. No soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-sm (4px) or rounded-md (6px) maximum. Sharp edges preferred.
visual_enhancers.textures: None. Prioritize stark, clean, terminal-like clarity over textures.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react (16px - 20px). Sharp, uniform stroke width. NO EMOJIS.

layouts.overall: Sidebar navigation (w-64) with sticky top header for breadcrumbs/actions. Content area takes remaining width.
layouts.forms: Multi-step wizard layout. Use a left-side vertical step indicator or top horizontal progress bar. Group inputs tightly using fieldsets.
layouts.output_viewer: Full-height container utilizing tabs for the 4 generated outputs (Clean, Annotated, Validation, Checklist).
layouts.diff_viewer: Side-by-side grid split (grid-cols-2). Synchronized scrolling if possible. Monospace rendering mandatory.
layouts.spacing: Dense. Use p-4 for cards, gap-4 for grids. Reduce standard Shadcn input heights from h-10 to h-8 for high-density forms.

grids.forms: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-x-4 gap-y-3 to pack multiple configuration parameters efficiently.
grids.rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use border-collapse patterns where applicable.

component_rules.cards: Flat solid background. 1px subtle border. No shadows. Use for project lists and dashboard stats.
component_rules.inputs: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Customize to be denser (h-8). Clear focus states (ring-1 ring-blue-500).
component_rules.buttons: Rectangular, dense. Primary actions use accent_primary. Secondary actions use surface_card with border.
component_rules.tabs: Override default Shadcn tabs to have a sharp, terminal-like underline indicator or solid active state without rounded corners.
component_rules.tables: Dense rows (py-2). Zebra striping optional but recommended for large datasets. Fixed headers for scrolling.

motion.philosophy: Utilitarian and instant. Network engineers hate waiting for animations.
motion.transitions: Extremely fast (duration-75 or duration-100) on hover states and color changes.
motion.entrance: None or minimal fade-in for page loads. No bouncy spring animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against dark backgrounds. Use text-white over accent colors.
accessibility.focus: Aggressive, high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none) on all inputs.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, form inputs, tabs, and output copy buttons.
accessibility.color_blindness: Use icons alongside status colors (e.g., TriangleAlert icon for warnings, CircleX for errors).

media.strategy: No images, avatars, or illustrations. Purely data, forms, and code blocks.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Implement the layout using a strict dark theme. DO NOT add a light mode toggle; this is a mandatory dark theme application.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Build a robust multi-step form for the 'New Configuration Project'. Ensure form state is managed cleanly across steps.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: For the Diff Viewer, implement a side-by-side layout comparing two text blocks. Use JetBrains Mono. Highlight added lines with green-500/15 background and removed lines with red-500/15 background.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The Generated Output section must feature a code-editor-like feel. Add a persistent 'Copy to Clipboard' button on the top right of the output container.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not build a consumer SaaS. Build an industrial tool. Spacing should be tight, information dense, and layout rigid.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use only lucide-react for icons. Do not use standard HTML selects; use Shadcn Select customized for dense layouts.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Ensure JSON/YAML import functionality has a clear drag-and-drop or text-area zone.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make the frontend look like a highly specialized, custom-built Cisco engineering tool.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through 1px borders and slight background color variations, NOT shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions ONLY for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Align to the top-left to mimic technical IDEs.
Always use dense, sharp button styles rather than pill-shaped bouncy buttons.
Components MUST use named exports; Pages MUST use default exports.
